units.source_text: 却说藤壶妃子乞假归宁，住在三条的宫邸中。

en.t: Now Lady Fujitsubo had asked for leave to return to her family home, and was staying at the palace residence at Sanjo.

units.source_text: 源氏公子颇想知道她的近况，前去访问。

en.t: Prince Genji was very eager to know how she had been, so he went to visit her.

units.source_text: 侍女王命妇、中纳言君、中务君等出来应接。

en.t: Her ladies in waiting, O no Myobu, Chunagon no Kimi, Nakatsukasa no Kimi, and the others came out to receive him.

units.source_text: 源氏公子想：“她们把我当作外客对待了。”

en.t: Prince Genji thought, They are treating me like an outside guest.

units.source_text: 但也不动声色，和她们作了些普通的寒暄。

en.t: Even so, he showed nothing on his face and exchanged only ordinary courtesies with them.

units.source_text: 此时妃子的哥哥兵部卿亲王正好也来到邸中，

en.t: At that moment the lady's elder brother, His Highness the Prince Minister of War, happened also to have come to the residence,

units.source_text: 听见源氏公子来访，便出来与他相见。

en.t: and when he heard that Prince Genji had come to call, he came out to meet him.

units.source_text: 源氏公子看看这个人，清秀俊逸，风流潇洒，心中窃思：

en.t: Prince Genji looked at him and saw how refined, handsome, graceful, and elegant he was, and secretly thought to himself:

units.source_text: 此人若是女子，何等姣好！

en.t: If this person were a woman, how beautiful he would be!

units.source_text: 因念对此人有双重关系[\[6\]](#part1336.html#m6)，倍觉亲切，

en.t: Remembering that he had a double bond with this man[\[6\]](#part1336.html#m6), Genji felt all the more affection for him,

units.source_text: 便和他促膝谈心，畅所欲言。

en.t: and so he sat close with him, spoke from the heart, and said freely whatever he wished to say.

units.source_text: 兵部卿亲王也觉得公子此次格外亲昵，情深意真，实甚可爱。

en.t: The Prince Minister of War also felt that Genji was especially intimate this time, sincere and deeply affectionate, and truly charming.

units.source_text: 他再也没有想到要把公子招为女婿，而倒是动了轻佻之心，

en.t: He no longer thought of taking the prince as a son in law, but instead was stirred by a frivolous fancy,
wishing only that Genji might turn into a woman.
